title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
source: Sick Bits Vol. 14 Matrix By Chris Chappell

ai_review.summary: A stellar matrix recording captures a transcendent 9/19/70 show, highlighted by an other‑worldly Dark Star, soaring St Stephen/NFA transition and luminous Lovelight.
ai_review.review: Listeners rave that the matrix blend gives the performance an incredible sense of space and presence, making every instrument feel right in front of you. The night’s centerpiece is a monumental Dark Star – described as “angelic” and “from another galaxy” – followed by a seamless St Stephen → Not Fade Away sandwich and a joyous Lovelight that showcases Pigpen’s wild charisma. Jerry Garcia’s tone (even with his new Vox wah‑wah) and the band’s exploratory chemistry are repeatedly praised, while the recording quality is called “beautiful,” “crisp,” and “excellent.”

ai_rating.rationale: Over 20 five‑star reviews with consistent praise for both the musical performance (especially Dark Star, St Stephen/NFA and Lovelight) and the matrix recording quality; only a few anomalous zero‑star entries that do not detract from overall sentiment.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note superb spatial imaging, clear instrument separation and a ‘hall’ effect that makes the show feel like being there; the matrix fixes volume fluctuations/dropouts present in the original soundboard.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Seamless transitions and exploratory jams create a flowing, almost cinematic set; the band stays in an improvisational zone throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his soaring tone, inventive phrasing and new Vox wah‑wah pedal work on Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Bob: Noted for building chords alongside Jerry during the jams, adding depth to the improvisations.
